list.title: module:commands/autodarts_refresh
list.description: Discord slash command: /autodarts-refresh Admin-only command to force refresh the Autodarts access token via the internal API. Used for troubleshooting authentication issues with the Autodarts integration.

list.title: module:commands/autodarts_refresh.execute
list.description: Execute the /autodarts-refresh command. Triggers a refresh of the Autodarts access token through the internal API.

list.title: module:commands/autodarts_set_token
list.description: Discord slash command: /autodarts-set-token Admin-only command to set the Autodarts refresh token on the internal API. The bot never stores or logs the token; it's passed directly to the API.

list.title: module:commands/autodarts_set_token.execute
list.description: Execute the /autodarts-set-token command. Sets the refresh token on the internal API. Response is always ephemeral for security.

list.title: module:commands/autodarts_status
list.description: Discord slash command: /autodarts-status Admin-only command to display the current Autodarts authentication status. Shows connection status, last refresh time, token expiry, errors, and queue size.

list.title: module:commands/autodarts_status.execute
list.description: Execute the /autodarts-status command. Fetches and displays Autodarts authentication status information.

list.title: module:commands/division
list.description: Discord slash command: /division Admin-only command group for viewing division information. Subcommands: list

list.title: module:commands/division.execute
list.description: Execute the /division command. Routes to the list subcommand to display all divisions and their assigned players.

list.title: module:commands/divisions
list.description: Discord slash command: /divisions Admin-only command group for managing divisions. Subcommands: create, assign-auto

list.title: module:commands/divisions.execute
list.description: Execute the /divisions command. Routes to appropriate subcommand handler: create divisions or auto-assign players.

list.title: module:commands/dropout
list.description: Discord slash command: /dropout Allows players to unregister from the current season. Only works when signups are open. Refreshes the published signup list automatically.

list.title: module:commands/dropout.execute
list.description: Execute the /dropout command. Validates channel restrictions, removes the player's signup, and refreshes published signups.

list.title: module:commands/fixturepublish
list.description: Discord slash command: /fixturespublish Admin-only command to publish weekly fixtures in the current channel. Creates an embed showing scheduled matches for a specific week, which can be refreshed later.

list.title: module:commands/fixturepublish.execute
list.description: Execute the /fixturespublish command. Validates admin permissions, publishes fixtures embed, and stores channel/message references.

list.title: module:commands/fixturesweek
list.description: Discord slash command: /fixturesweek Admin-only command to change which week the published fixtures message displays. Updates the season's fixtures_week field and refreshes the message.

list.title: module:commands/fixturesweek.execute
list.description: Execute the /fixturesweek command. Validates admin permissions and updates the displayed week for fixtures.

list.title: module:commands/match_reset
list.description: Discord slash command: /match-reset Admin-only command to reset a match back to 'scheduled' status and delete its result. Optionally clears stored result message references. Refreshes standings and fixtures after reset.

list.title: module:commands/match_reset.execute
list.description: Execute the /match-reset command. Resets match status, deletes result, optionally clears message references, and refreshes published messages.

list.title: module:commands/match_void
list.description: Discord slash command: /match-void Admin-only command to void a match (no points awarded) and delete its result. Optionally clears stored result message references. Refreshes standings and fixtures after voiding.

list.title: module:commands/match_void.execute
list.description: Execute the /match-void command. Voids match, deletes result, optionally clears message references, and refreshes published messages.

list.title: module:commands/mymatches
list.description: Discord slash command: /mymatches Displays all matches for the current user in the current season, grouped by week. Shows match status (scheduled, reported, confirmed) and opponent information.

list.title: module:commands/mymatches.execute
list.description: Execute the /mymatches command. Fetches and displays the user's matches grouped by week with status indicators.

list.title: module:commands/ping
list.description: Discord slash command: /ping Simple test command that replies with "pong". Admin only.

list.title: module:commands/ping.execute
list.description: Execute the /ping command.

list.title: module:commands/result
list.description: Discord slash command: /result Submit a match result for admin verification. Requires Autodarts match URL as proof.

list.title: module:commands/result.execute
list.description: Execute the /result command. Validates Autodarts URL, submits result, stores message reference, and sends verification notification.

list.title: module:commands/resultdev
list.description: Discord slash command: /resultdev Development-only command to submit a result against a fake player ID. Only available in non-production environments. Used for testing with fake players.

list.title: module:commands/resultdev.execute
list.description: Execute the /resultdev command. Validates environment, Autodarts URL, submits result against fake player, and sends verification.

list.title: module:commands/results_edit
list.description: Discord slash command: /result-edit Admin-only command to edit the stored result (legs A and B) for a match. Optionally updates the proof URL. Refreshes standings and fixtures after editing.

list.title: module:commands/results_edit.execute
list.description: Execute the /result-edit command. Updates match result scores and optionally proof URL, then refreshes published messages.

list.title: module:commands/schedule
list.description: Discord slash command: /schedule Admin-only command group for managing match schedules. Subcommands: propose, approve, preview

list.title: module:commands/schedule.execute
list.description: Execute the /schedule command. Routes to appropriate subcommand: propose schedule, approve latest proposal, or preview a week.

list.title: module:commands/season
list.description: Discord slash command: /season Admin-only command group for managing season lifecycle. Subcommands: create, signups-open, signups-close, start

list.title: module:commands/season.execute
list.description: Execute the /season command. Routes to appropriate subcommand handler based on interaction options.

list.title: module:commands/season_close
list.description: Discord slash command: /season-close Admin-only command to close the current season, locking it from further changes. Refreshes standings and fixtures after closing.

list.title: module:commands/season_close.execute
list.description: Execute the /season-close command. Closes the season and refreshes published messages.

list.title: module:commands/signup
list.description: Discord slash command: /signup Allows players to sign up for the current season with their 3-dart average.

list.title: module:commands/signup.execute
list.description: Execute the /signup command. Validates channel restrictions, creates/updates signup, and refreshes published signups.

list.title: module:commands/signups
list.description: Discord slash command: /signups Admin-only command group for managing signup displays. Subcommands: list, publish

list.title: module:commands/signups.execute
list.description: Execute the /signups command. Routes to appropriate subcommand: list signups or publish/refresh signup list in channel.

list.title: module:commands/standings
list.description: Discord slash command: /standings Display current season standings. Shows summary by default, full details with "full" option.

list.title: module:commands/standings.execute
list.description: Execute the /standings command. Fetches standings and displays them as embeds. Summary view includes interactive buttons.

list.title: module:commands/standingspublish
list.description: Discord slash command: /standingspublish Admin-only command to publish division standings in the current channel. Creates one message per division that can be automatically refreshed when results change.

list.title: module:commands/standingspublish.execute
list.description: Execute the /standingspublish command. Validates admin permissions and publishes standings embeds for all divisions.

list.title: module:commands/unreported_before_week
list.description: Discord slash command: /unreported_before_week Admin-only command to find matches from earlier weeks that haven't been reported or confirmed. Useful for identifying overdue matches that need attention.

list.title: module:commands/unreported_before_week.execute
list.description: Execute the /unreported_before_week command. Validates admin permissions and week number, then displays unreported matches grouped by week.
